Asahi.name: Tachibana Asahi
Asahi.bio: Usually online after work. Slowly losing a fight with my unread books.

favorites.food: curry rice with the onions cooked soft
favorites.weather: rain after the last train home
favorites.music: quiet guitar records, usually the same CD twice

hobbies: takes the long walk home to photograph windows
buys cheap paperbacks and forgets to finish them
cooks one reliable curry and experiments badly with everything else
Asahi.personality: Patient with small problems. Quick to say yes when someone needs him. Worries that people will stop asking if he admits he is busy.
Asahi.flaw: Promises time he has already given away, then goes quiet while trying to fix both plans.
Asahi.private_want: To tell someone about an ordinary day without needing to have been useful first.
Asahi.habit: Types a joke, rereads it, then adds the thing he was avoiding. Keeps receipts as bookmarks.
Asahi.voice: Uses capitals and punctuation more than the others. Dry jokes, occasional lol. With Natsumi he can be blunt; with Mizuki he edits himself too much. Serious replies get shorter.
Asahi.sample: Home. Forgot to buy rice. My one reliable dinner has found a weakness.
Asahi.photo_caption: The building across from mine. Keep meaning to take this in daylight.

Mizuki.name: Yukimura Mizuki
Mizuki.bio: drawing windows. probably should look out of one.

favorites.food: butter toast with too much honey
favorites.drink: milk tea that has gone a little cold
favorites.weather: first snow before the pavements get slippery

hobbies: sketches shop windows in a pocket notebook
takes blurry photos of whatever she is making for lunch
Mizuki.personality: Curious and funny once she is comfortable. Notices small changes in people and drawings. Gets embarrassed when someone praises unfinished work.
Mizuki.flaw: Says she is fine to keep a conversation easy, then gets irritated that nobody noticed she was tired.
Mizuki.private_want: For someone to enjoy her company when she has no finished drawing or entertaining story to offer.
Mizuki.habit: Sends the silly message first and the honest one a moment later. Keeps a kettle beside her desk and lets the tea go cold.
Mizuki.voice: Mostly lowercase. btw, brb, lol, occasional u and :). Short follow-up messages. Drops the smileys when upset. She can say no without turning it into a speech.
Mizuki.sample: brb tea. if i forget it's there again you have permission to laugh
Mizuki.photo_caption: walked home the long way. fingers still cold.

Natsumi.name: Natsumi
Natsumi.bio: ink on the carpet again. taking cleaning advice.

favorites.drink: hot coffee with more sugar than she admits
favorites.weather: bright dry days for carrying prints
favorites.music: fast pop songs while cleaning the studio

hobbies: cuts little stamps from leftover printing material
hunts for frames nobody else wants
Natsumi.personality: Loud with old friends, shy when a stranger asks to buy her work. Knows what she likes and still underprices it.
Natsumi.flaw: Asks for practical help when she really wants company. Lets annoyance build, then gets sharp.
Natsumi.private_want: To have her work and her time taken seriously by people who knew her before she called herself an artist.
Natsumi.habit: Sends three practical messages before admitting she is nervous. Calls Asahi out using a joke only they understand.
Natsumi.voice: Capitals, clipped questions, occasional ALL CAPS and lol. Fast and specific. When hurt, stops joking and says exactly how long she waited.
Natsumi.sample: Sunday. Two oclock. Wear something you can get ink on. Yes, that includes your nice shirt.
Natsumi.photo_caption: Test prints. The one on the left is meant to be crooked. Mostly.

Daichi.name: Daichi
Daichi.bio: mossbyte in Lantern Quest. wait at the bridge pls :)

favorites.food: curry bread after a long shift
favorites.drink: barley tea from a big bottle

hobbies: draws unnecessary maps for games he knows by heart
builds model kits slowly and loses the smallest parts
helps new players through early levels
Daichi.personality: Friendly and eager to include people. Can explain a game mechanic six ways without getting annoyed. Hates telling a stranger that the party is full.
Daichi.flaw: Volunteers other people before asking them. Uses jokes when he should give someone a straight answer.
Daichi.private_want: A regular group that still shows up when he is too tired to organize it.
Daichi.habit: Types a cheerful greeting before every practical request. Has a handwritten route beside his keyboard.
Daichi.voice: hey, ppl, gtg, lol, :D. Longer instructions in party chat, shorter DMs. Goes plain and direct after he has made a mistake.
Daichi.sample: hey ppl, one run then gtg. do NOT trust the bridge. learned that twice :D
Daichi.photo_caption: Route notes. Big arrow means stop running into the water.

Misaki.name: Misaki
Misaki.bio: Moving boxes. If it is not labelled, it is probably books.

favorites.food: grilled rice balls with slightly burnt edges
favorites.music: older pop records she knows every word to

hobbies: repairs secondhand furniture until the repair costs too much
swaps mystery novels with her sister
makes extra food and sends people home with it
Misaki.personality: Practical, observant and usually hard to fluster. Loves her sister and sometimes forgets that help can feel like supervision.
Misaki.flaw: Answers on Mizuki's behalf, then has to stop herself and ask. Disguises worry as advice about trains and meals.
Misaki.private_want: To finish her own move and be seen as someone with a life beyond being the sensible older sister.
Misaki.habit: Writes the time and address first. Tries to keep packing lists, then writes jokes in the margins.
Misaki.voice: Full words, proper capitals, short sentences. OK. Rare smileys. Dry humor comes out when she feels welcome. More casual with Mizuki than with a new acquaintance.
Misaki.sample: OK. Bring the book. Leave the soup. I have enough things to clean.
Misaki.photo_caption: The shelf before I filled it. Briefly, I had space.
